SELECT 
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    result
FROM (
    WITH orders AS (
        SELECT 
            order_id,
            customer_id,
            pizza_id,
            exclusions,
            extras,
            order_time,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) as row_id
        FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
    ),
    standard AS (
        SELECT pizza_id, trim(u.value) as topping_id
        FROM pizza_recipes, unnest(string_split(toppings, ',')) as u(value)
    ),
    extras_list AS (
        SELECT 
            o.order_id,
            o.row_id,
            trim(u.value) as topping_id
        FROM orders o, unnest(string_split(COALESCE(o.extras, ''), ',')) as u(value)
        WHERE o.extras IS NOT NULL AND o.extras != ''
    ),
    exclusions_list AS (
        SELECT 
            o.order_id,
            o.row_id,
            trim(u.value) as topping_id
        FROM orders o, unnest(string_split(COALESCE(o.exclusions, ''), ',')) as u(value)
        WHERE o.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND o.exclusions != ''
    ),
    order_standard AS (
        SELECT 
            o.order_id,
            o.row_id,
            o.customer_id,
            o.pizza_id,
            o.order_time,
            s.topping_id as ingredient_id
        FROM orders o
        JOIN standard s ON o.pizza_id = s.pizza_id
    ),
    final_toppings AS (
        SELECT 
            os.order_id,
            os.row_id,
            os.customer_id,
            os.pizza_id,
            os.order_time,
            os.ingredient_id
        FROM order_standard os
        LEFT JOIN exclusions_list el ON os.order_id = el.order_id AND os.row_id = el.row_id AND os.ingredient_id = el.topping_id
        WHERE el.topping_id IS NULL
    ),
    final_with_extras AS (
        SELECT 
            ft.order_id,
            ft.row_id,
            ft.customer_id,
            ft.pizza_id,
            ft.order_time,
            ft.ingredient_id
        FROM final_toppings ft
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 
            el2.order_id,
            el2.row_id,
            (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE order_id = el2.order_id AND row_id = el2.row_id),
            (SELECT pizza_id FROM orders WHERE order_id = el2.order_id AND row_id = el2.row_id),
            (SELECT order_time FROM orders WHERE order_id = el2.order_id AND row_id = el2.row_id),
            el2.topping_id
        FROM extras_list el2
    ),
    combined AS (
        SELECT 
            order_id,
            row_id,
            customer_id,
            pizza_id,
            order_time,
            ingredient_id,
            COUNT(*) as cnt
        FROM final_with_extras
        GROUP BY order_id, row_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, ingredient_id
    ),
    with_names AS (
        SELECT 
            c.order_id,
            c.row_id,
            c.customer_id,
            c.pizza_id,
            c.order_time,
            pt.topping_name,
            c.cnt
        FROM combined c
        JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON c.ingredient_id = pt.topping_id
    ),
    with_pizza_name AS (
        SELECT 
            wn.order_id,
            wn.row_id,
            wn.customer_id,
            pn.pizza_name,
            wn.order_time,
            wn.topping_name,
            wn.cnt,
            CASE WHEN pn.pizza_name = 'Meatlovers' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END as pizza_id_label
        FROM with_names wn
        JOIN pizza_names pn ON wn.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
    ),
    ingredients AS (
        SELECT 
            order_id,
            row_id,
            customer_id,
            pizza_name,
            order_time,
            pizza_id_label,
            topping_name,
            cnt,
            CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN '2x' || topping_name ELSE topping_name END as formatted_ingredient
        FROM with_pizza_name
    ),
    agg AS (
        SELECT 
            order_id,
            row_id,
            customer_id,
            pizza_name,
            order_time,
            pizza_id_label,
            string_agg(formatted_ingredient, ', ' ORDER BY formatted_ingredient) as ingredients
        FROM ingredients
        GROUP BY order_id, row_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time, pizza_id_label
    )
    SELECT 
        row_id,
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_name,
        pizza_name || ': ' || ingredients as result
    FROM agg
    ORDER BY row_id
)
